newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Quake rocks Colombia's northwest jungle.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks Colombia's northwest jungle.

text.p: An earthquake rocked northwest Colombia on Tuesday in a jungle-covered area near the border with Panama, authorities said.

There were no immediate reports of damage or injury from the quake, which measured 5.1 on the Richter scale and was capable of causing considerable damage in a populated area, a spokesman for the national seismological institute said.
The epicentre of the temblor, which occurred at 12:31 p.m. (1731 GMT), was located near the town of Jurado in Choco province about 280 miles (450 km) northwest of Bogota.
